flood: <red><bold>Too many attempts</bold></red><newline><gray>You're connecting too fast. Wait a few seconds and try again.</gray>
block: <red><bold>You can't join right now</bold></red><newline><gray>Player: <white>{username}</white></gray><newline><gray>Your access to this server is blocked at the moment.</gray><newline><gray>If you think this is a mistake, contact the server staff.</gray>
block.vpn: <red><bold>You can't join right now</bold></red><newline><gray>Player: <white>{username}</white></gray><newline><gray>If you are using a VPN or proxy, turn it off and try again.</gray><newline><gray>If you think this is a mistake, contact the server staff.</gray>
block.game_relay:
<gold><bold>✖ Turn off your game accelerator</bold></gold>
<gray>Your connection goes through an accelerator or relay. Close it and try again.</gray>
maxperip: <red><bold>Too many accounts at once</bold></red><newline><gray>The maximum number of accounts connected from your network at the same time has been reached. Close one session and try again.</gray>
cmd.reloaded: Config reloaded, cache cleared and blocks resyncing.
cmd.reloadFail: Config NOT reloaded: config.yml has an error. The previous settings are still in use; check the console.
cmd.savefail: Couldn't save the key to config.yml (write permissions?).
cmd.keysaved: Key saved. Connecting to the Jarvis server…
cmd.active: ✓ License active. Jarvis is now protecting the server (no restart).
cmd.validatefail: Key saved, but it couldn't be validated with the Jarvis server yet. This may be a temporary connection drop; it will retry in the background. If the warning persists, check that the key is correct.
cmd.keyrejected: The Jarvis server REJECTED the key. The server is NOT protected. Fix the license key.
cmd.degradedWhy: The Jarvis server is not responding: players are getting in without being checked. Blocks already known here and the repeated-connection limit still apply.
cmd.behindProxy: This server does not check by IP (server.behind-proxy): protection depends on the proxy.
log.pairedUnprotected: Jarvis linked but NOT protected yet (couldn't validate the license); retrying in the background.
cmd.descKey: set your license key without restarting (console)
cmd.descReload: reload config, clear cache and resync blocks
cmd.descBlacklist: block a player (follows them even if they change IP)
cmd.blacklistFail: Could not reach the Jarvis server. Try again.
cmd.notLinked: Not sent: this server is not linked to a license yet. Finish the pairing link shown in the console, or run /antivpn key <license>.
cmd.descWhitelist: let a player skip the check (you can set a time)
cmd.whitelistBadTime: I do not understand that time. Use 30m, 12h, 7d, 2w or "perma".
cmd.descDoctor: check that everything is working, and what to fix if not
cmd.diagClockOff: off by {ms} ms from the Jarvis server; fix NTP on this machine
cmd.diagPanelDown: down: blocks and settings from the panel are not arriving here
cmd.diagPanelAuth: rejected: check the license key in config.yml and run /antivpn reload
cmd.diagIpPrivate: we are receiving {ip}, which is not the player's; check how the real IP reaches this server
cmd.diagAllOk: Everything is working. Nothing to do.
